reason: My firm has around 10 staff so we exceed the 5-seat Pioneer plan, and jumping straight to Pro at ₹4,999 to ₹5,999 a month is far too steep for my frugal budget. I will start on the free sandbox to test the Drive permissions with two trainees first rather than committing upfront.
objection: Will connecting my Google Drive give Docketra access to read all my firm's private files?
would_change_my_mind: A mid-sized firm tier around ₹20,000 to ₹25,000 a year covering 10 to 12 staff, plus verified proof during sandbox onboarding that Google Drive access is strictly limited to Docketra's folder.
